title: Settings
description: Manage your account settings and preferences.

security.title: Security Settings
security.description: Configure security settings for your application.
security.indexDescription: Manage security settings, password policies, and access restrictions.
security.quickLinkDescription: Configure security settings and access controls.
security.ipRestrictionsDescription: Restrict access to specific IP addresses or ranges. Leave empty to allow access from anywhere.

system.title: System Settings
system.description: Configure global system settings for your application.
system.indexDescription: Manage global system settings, branding, and maintenance mode.
system.quickLinkDescription: Configure global system settings and maintenance mode.
system.maintenanceWarning: When maintenance mode is enabled, users will not be able to access the application.

profile.title: Profile Information
profile.description: Update your profile information and preferences.
profile.indexDescription: Manage your personal information, contact details, and location settings.
profile.quickLinkDescription: Update your profile information and photo.
profile.emailManaged: Email is managed by your authentication provider

account.title: Account Settings
account.description: Manage your account security and preferences.
account.indexDescription: Manage your account security, connected accounts, and account deletion.
account.quickLinkDescription: Update your password and security settings.
account.twoFactorDescription: Add an extra layer of security to your account by requiring a verification code in addition to your password.
account.twoFactorInstructions: We'll send you a verification code via email or SMS when you sign in from a new device or browser.
account.deleteWarning: Once you delete your account, there is no going back. Please be certain.
account.deleteConfirmTitle: Are you sure you want to delete your account?
account.deleteConfirmMessage: This action cannot be undone. All of your data will be permanently deleted. Please type 'delete' to confirm.

notifications.title: Notification Settings
notifications.description: Control which notifications you receive and how you receive them.
notifications.indexDescription: Manage your notification preferences for email, push, and in-app notifications.
notifications.quickLinkDescription: Configure how and when you receive notifications.

appearance.title: Appearance Settings
appearance.description: Customize the look and feel of the application.
appearance.indexDescription: Customize the appearance of the admin dashboard to suit your preferences.
appearance.quickLinkDescription: Change theme, colors, and layout options.
appearance.themeDescription: Choose between light, dark, or system theme based on your device settings.
appearance.colorDescription: Select the primary color for buttons, links, and other UI elements.
appearance.previewText: This is how your text will look with the selected font size.
appearance.denseModeDescription: Reduce spacing between elements for a more compact view.
appearance.sidebarDescription: Start with the sidebar collapsed by default.
appearance.animationsDescription: Enable or disable UI animations and transitions.

api.title: API Settings
api.description: Manage your API keys and webhooks for integrating with external services.
api.indexDescription: Manage API keys and webhooks for integrating with external services.
api.quickLinkDescription: Configure API access and webhook integrations.
